source_note: Primary source: ARRI Formats & Data Rate Calculator v2.6.4 (https://tools.arri.com/fileadmin/adapps/afdc/index.html); numbers read from its embedded dataset https://tools.arri.com/fileadmin/adapps/afdc/js/data-embed.js (header: generated 2026-05-26). bpp = bytes_per_frame*8/(file W*H); Mbps@24 = bytes_per_frame*24*8/1e6 (FDRC formula, audio excluded).

cameras.name: ARRI ALEXA 35

codecs.name: ARRIRAW
codecs.ref: ARRI FDRC v2.6.4: 4.6K 3:2 Open Gate (4608x3164) = 23219804 bytes/frame -> 4458.2 Mb/s at 24 fps (557.3 MB/s); bpp=12.7409. bpp across modes 12.7409-12.774; per-mode values in byRes.

codecs.name: ARRIRAW HDE
codecs.ref: ESTIMATE: ARRI FDRC shows ARRIRAW-HDE GB/h as ARRIRAW GB/h x hde_multiplier (0.5 for this camera); 4.6K 3:2 Open Gate (4608x3164) 24 fps ~= 2229.1 Mb/s. HDE is lossless/variable-rate, so real files vary with image content. The multiplier is the FDRC's own approximation; ARRI marketing commonly cites roughly 40% smaller files (not re-verified here). No fixed ARRI-published HDE Mb/s found.

cameras.notes: Data from ARRI Formats & Data Rate Calculator (FDRC) v2.6.4 embedded dataset (generated 2026-05-26). Data rate is constant bytes/frame x fps (FDRC: Mb/s = bytes_per_frame*fps*8/1e6), so bpp is fps-independent. maxfps = highest value FDRC lists across Compact Drive 1TB/2TB (ARRIRAW on 1TB drives is lower, e.g. 4.6K OG 35 fps). FDRC lists only ProRes 422 HQ/4444/4444 XQ + ARRIRAW for ALEXA 35 (no ProRes 422/LT, no ARRICORE). ARRICORE remains ALEXA 35 Xtreme-only per ARRI SUP 5.1.0 notes (third-party report, Newsshooter); not re-verified for SUP 6.2.0. In ProRes, the 4.6K 16:9 sensor mode records 4K (4096x2304) downsampled. Anamorphic ProRes entries record a 2x-squeezed file. ProRes is VBR in practice; FDRC uses Apple target rates.

cameras.notes: Data from ARRI FDRC v2.6.4 embedded dataset. Xtreme adds ARRICORE (RGB codec; launched beta July 2025, out of beta with SUP 5.1.0) and higher frame rates (330 fps full DR, up to 660 fps with Sensor Overdrive at 11 stops). Per-codec maxfps in 'byRes'; ARRICORE also has Sensor Overdrive max fps ('maxfps_overdrive'). FDRC ARRIRAW bytes/frame for Xtreme are ~2.7% larger than ALEXA 35 for the same mode (13.08 vs 12.74 bpp at 4.6K OG); reproduced as published. Xtreme ProRes can record 4.6K 16:9 natively (ALEXA 35 downsamples to 4K).

cameras.notes: Data from ARRI FDRC v2.6.4. ALEXA Mini (ALEV III Super 35). ARRIRAW recorded as 2.8K 16:9 (2880x1620) or Open Gate 3.4K (3424x2202; 4:3 2.8K and anamorphic ARRIRAW modes record the full 3424x2202 OG container with crop metadata). FDRC ProRes rates are a fixed bpp formula per flavor (constant ~3.98 bpp for 422 HQ etc.). FDRC dataset also contains ProRes 422 LT rates (1.849 bpp) but the camera's FDRC codec list omits LT, so it is excluded here (ARRI Mini spec sheets do list ProRes 422 LT - add if needed). ProRes 4444 XQ fps limits are lower (30 fps at 3.2K/UHD, 120 at HD). 4K UHD and 3.2K ProRes need the 4K UHD license; UHD is upsampled from 3.2K.
